import random

# Define a list of magic ability categories
categories = ["Elemental", "Arcane", "Divine", "Nature", "Technomancy"]

# Define a list of magic ability ranks
ranks = ["Novice", "Apprentice", "Adept", "Master", "Legend"]

# Define a list of magic ability limitations
limitations = ["Physical toll", "Magical exhaustion", "Unstable energy", "Dependence on specific materials", "Vulnerability to specific elements"]

# Define a list of magic ability costs
costs = ["Mental focus", "Physical stamina", "Magical energy", "Material resources", "Temporal consequences"]

# Define a list of magic ability descriptions
descriptions = [
    "Unleashes a burst of elemental energy, dealing damage to all enemies within a small radius.",
    "Creates a localized distortion of reality, allowing the user to teleport short distances.",
    "Calls upon the power of the divine, granting the user temporary invincibility.",
    "Manipulates the growth and decay of plants to heal or harm allies and enemies.",
    "Harnesses the power of technology to create complex machines and devices."
]

# Define a list of overpowered magic abilities
overpowered_abilities = [
    "Unleashes a catastrophic event, destroying a large area and dealing massive damage to all enemies.",
    "Grants the user immense power and control over reality, but at the cost of their sanity and physical well-being.",
    "Allows the user to manipulate time and space, but only for a short duration and with significant consequences.",
    "Unleashes a massive amount of energy, dealing damage to all enemies and potentially altering the environment.",
    "Grants the user immense magical power, but only if they are willing to sacrifice their own life force."
]

def generate_magic_ability():
    # Randomly select a category
    category = random.choice(categories)

    # Randomly select a rank
    rank = random.choice(ranks)

    # Randomly select a limitation
    limitation = random.choice(limitations)

    # Randomly select a cost
    cost = random.choice(costs)

    # Randomly select a description
    description = random.choice(descriptions)

    # Randomly select an overpowered ability (if applicable)
    if random.random() < 0.01:
        overpowered_ability = random.choice(overpowered_abilities)
        return {
            "name": f"{category} {rank} Ability: {random.choice([ability.split(":")[0] for ability in overpowered_abilities])}",
            "description": overpowered_ability,
            "limitation": limitation,
            "cost": cost,
            "rank": rank
        }
    else:
        return {
            "name": f"{category} {rank} Ability: {random.choice([ability.split(":")[0] for ability in descriptions])}",
            "description": description,
            "limitation": limitation,
            "cost": cost,
            "rank": rank
        }

# Generate 10 magic abilities
for _ in range(10):
    ability = generate_magic_ability()
    print(ability)
